purpose: Teach: 振り込み/括弧/持ち物/鋭意/即刻/告示/第一線/積算

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、給与振り込みを毎月厳守された
lines.en: When he founded the company, Dad was meticulous about salary payments. Never missed a month.
lines.style: Quiet, measured opening. Warm nostalgia in the voice. Gentle pride. Lets each phrase land without rush. A man remembering something he honored about his father.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは契約書の括弧書きまで気を配られた
lines.en: Yes. He paid attention to every detail—even the fine print of contracts.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Not echoing, but confirming with his own quiet understanding. Each phrase deliberate. Shoulders slightly forward with the weight of the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の持ち物に余計な負担をかけなかったぞ
lines.en: And he never burdened his staff with unnecessary costs. That was important to him.
lines.style: Voice softens. Almost reflective, as if seeing his father clearly in the moment he's describing. Slight pause before 'important'—choosing the word carefully.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新事業に鋭意取り組まれた
lines.en: Yes. He threw himself into developing new ventures. That drive never stopped.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Calm, measured pacing. There's admiration here, but not performed—just stated as fact. A son speaking what he knows to be true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、品質クレームには即刻ご対応された
lines.en: When quality complaints came in, he responded immediately. Not delegating that responsibility.
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 'immediately'—not rushed, but purposeful. Voice carries the weight of understanding why that mattered. A pause before the final thought, letting it settle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは新店舗開業の告示を自ら出された
lines.en: Yes. He made the announcements for new store openings himself. That was his role to own.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Speaking with the understanding of someone who watched his father take responsibility seriously. Measured pace. Slight warmth on 'himself'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界第一線を走り続けられたぞ
lines.en: He stayed at the forefront of the industry. Right up to the end.
lines.style: Voice lifts slightly with pride. Not boastful—factual. There's finality here, and acceptance. Slow pace, letting the legacy land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは費用の積算を厳密にされた
lines.en: Yes. He was rigorous about cost calculations. Precision mattered to him.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Warm and measured. A gentle close—this is the last thing being remembered. Voice settles, almost like a benediction. Quiet certainty.
